it.txt: É presidente do Tribunal de Justiça de Alagoas e assumiu o governo de forma interina em 14/10/2026, durante as férias do governador Paulo Dantas (MDB); ele assumiu porque o cargo de vice está vago e o presidente da Assembleia Legislativa, que viria antes na ordem de substituição, não assumiu por estar em viagem
it.txt_en: He is the president of the Alagoas Court of Justice (the state's highest court). He became acting governor on October 14, 2026, while Governor Paulo Dantas (MDB) is on vacation. He took over because the vice governor post is empty and the president of the Legislative Assembly (state parliament), who comes before him in the line of succession, did not take over because he was traveling.

fontes.titulo: Fábio Bittencourt assume interinamente o Governo de Alagoas
